title: AIOS Unit — Standard
description: Frontmatter for a standards/ unit. Extends base.schema.json. Prose content (Rule Definitions, Anti-patterns, Examples) lives in the markdown body per standards/README.md; frontmatter carries only machine-actionable fields.

scope.description: What this standard applies to (a language, a layer, all of Guardrail Hub).

applies_to.description: Repository path globs this standard is checked against — enables the mechanical diff-vs-glob enforcement described in Decision 0001's Automation split.

severity_default.description: Whether a violation blocks by default (Mandatory Rule) or is a recommendation. Individual rules in the body may refine this.

enforced_by.description: ids of skills/ units that enforce this standard when applied.
